question: How does offering all action to the lord free one from action-bonds?
premises: thus one is freed from action-bonds by auspicious and inauspicious fruits
united with renunciation-yoga one freed approaches me
other-god worshippers have limited desires and diminish fruit
therefore by previously stated teaching order do contemplation as offering-to-me as me-ness
inference: renunciation-yoga is offering all action to the lord with recognition of me-ness
uncertainties: fused sandhi surfaces kept as single rows
plain_english: Thus you will be freed from the bonds of action by auspicious and inauspicious fruits; united with renunciation-yoga and freed, you will approach me. Worshippers of other gods have limited desires and diminish the fruit; therefore you, by the previously stated teaching order, do contemplation as offering to me, as me-ness. This indeed is renunciation-yoga, already stated extensively and almost clearly before.
